import { LinkCard, CardGrid } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Short, task-focused recipes. Each guide solves **one** concrete job with a
minimal snippet taken from a real example app, and assumes you already have an
app skeleton building — if you don't, start with the
[Quickstart](/build/quickstart/).

| I want to… | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| Pick the right table or collection and read/write it | [Tables & Collections](/build/collections/) |
| Notify clients that something changed | [Emit events](/build/guides/events/) |
| Tell or ask another app | [Cross-app calls](/build/guides/cross-context/) |
| Store a large binary and read it back | [Files and blobs](/build/guides/blobs/) |
| Find records by the words in them | [Search your app's data](/build/guides/search/) |
| Check a captcha or a payment with an outside service, using a secret the app never sees | [Call an external service](/build/guides/outbound/) |
| Run long work over private files outside the log | [Compute actions](/build/guides/compute-actions/) |
| Restrict who may call a method or write a record | [Access control](/build/guides/access-control/) |
| Let several people edit one text at once | [Collaborative text](/build/guides/collaborative-text/) |
| Call the app from TypeScript or Python with types, and catch breaking changes before publishing | [Typed clients for your app](/build/guides/typed-clients/) |
